```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(Metaweb)
```


Load the interaction data from the package 

```{r}
data <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "size_barnes2008_FF.csv", package = "Metaweb"), sep = ",", dec = ".")  # adjust sep/dec if needed
head(data)
```
